paper.title: TopRank+: A Refinement of TopRank Algorithm

settings.name_in_paper: Online learning to rank in a generalized stochastic click model (TopRank setting, Assumptions 1-4)
unmapped: Learner ranks L items, displays the top K positions and observes binary clicks on each displayed item
General click model v(a,k)=alpha(a(k))*chi(a,k) satisfying Assumptions 1-4 (nests cascade and position-based models)
settings.definition_quote: Assume there are L items to be ranked, indexed by i=1,2, …, L. ... only the first K most attractive items are of interest. Information is provided sequentially in the form of user clicks. ... For each round, the algorithm provides a permutation A_t of all items based on previous clicks, display the first K items to the user, and collect new clicks.
